What does Monte Carlo Probability mean?

Monte Carlo simulation runs thousands of random price paths to estimate odds. A 67% probability of rising does not mean it will rise. It means that in 67% of simulated paths, the price was higher after 20 days. The other 33% paths still happen in real life.

What does MACD mean?

MACD shows the relationship between two moving averages of price. When the MACD line crosses above the signal line, momentum is shifting up. When it crosses below, momentum is shifting down. Divergences — when price rises but MACD falls — are early warning signals.

What does RSI mean?

RSI (Relative Strength Index) measures momentum on a 0-100 scale. Above 70 usually means the asset is overbought — buyers may be exhausted. Below 30 means oversold — selling pressure may be fading. It is not a timing tool; it tells you what already happened, not what comes next.

Why does Bollinger Bands matter for my decision?

Bollinger Bands wrap around the price like an elastic band. When price touches the upper band, the asset may be overextended. When it touches the lower band, it may be oversold. Squeezes — when bands narrow — often precede big moves, but do not predict direction.
